6.32 rsPageBreakOnGaugeGroup
Applies to RDL 2008/01, RDL 2010/01, and RDL 2016/01
rsPageBreakOnGaugeGroup is a non-critical error that will occur when a GaugePanel.PageBreak
element is set to create a page break for each Group within the GaugePanel.
